requirements.label: 124 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BFA in Musical Theatre requires a minimum of 124 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-SMTD credits (30)
requirements.hint: At least 30 credits outside SMTD. Courses within Arts Administration also count as non-SMTD.

requirements.label: Musical Theatre core (11 courses)
requirements.hint: Intro to Musical Theatre I and II, Intro to Musical Theatre Acting I and II, Ensemble Techniques, Performance I-IV, and History of Musical Theatre I and II. A grade below C- in MUSTHTRE 235 or 236 does not count. After MUSTHTRE 236, all majors complete a second year evaluation that qualifies them for upper level performance courses.

requirements.label: MUSTHTRE 280/480: Production Performance (3 terms if cast)
requirements.hint: Minimum 3 terms if cast. Majors must audition for all mainstage musical productions and accept any role in which they are cast; students cast in a faculty directed musical or play enroll in 280 or 480 for at least one credit.

requirements.label: Theatre core (5 courses)
requirements.hint: THTREMUS 282 Heightened Language and Text, 382 20th and 21st Century American Realism, 383 Acting for the Camera I, 250 Intro to Theatre Practices, and 251 Run Crew. A grade below C- in THTREMUS 282, 382, or 383 does not count.

requirements.label: Theatre History (2 courses)
requirements.hint: Two courses in Theatre History, such as Theatre History I or II, American Theatre and Drama, Contemporary American Theatre and Drama, Intercultural Drama, or Topics in African American Theatre. One course may be fulfilled by the Race and Ethnicity requirement.

requirements.label: Theatre Management elective (1 term)
requirements.hint: One term of a Theatre management course, such as Stage Management, Performing Arts Management, Practicum in Arts Management, Producing in the American Theatre, Fundraising and the Arts, or Legal Issues in the Theatre.

requirements.label: Ballet (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of Ballet for Musical Theatre. A grade below C- in a Dance class does not count.

requirements.label: Dance credits (12)
requirements.hint: Minimum 12 credits of dance, including the Ballet, Dance Styles, and Tap terms, completed with dance electives such as Choreography or Dance Workshop.

requirements.label: Class Piano (2 courses)
requirements.hint: Two courses in Class Piano depending on placement: PIANO 110 and 111, or 111 and 112. Students may test out via proficiency.

requirements.label: Music Theory (4 credits)
requirements.hint: Minimum 4 credits of music theory, normally MT Theory I and II (MUSTHTRE 155 and 156). Other Music Theory coursework also counts.

requirements.label: Voice Performance (24 credits)
requirements.hint: Minimum 24 credits of MT Applied Voice, or completion of VOICE 426; elected each term.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity course
requirements.hint: One course in Race and Ethnicity selected from approved courses within LSA, or within SMTD by petition. SMTD RE courses will not count into overall non-SMTD credits.

requirements.label: Foreign language (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of a foreign language, or proficiency.

requirements.label: American or World History
requirements.hint: One American or World History course, 3 to 4 credits.
